$description: Cucusa brand palette v2 — social-first, solved to luminance targets. Generated by brand/palette.mjs; do not edit by hand.

paper.$description: Default ground. Near-white tinted cool toward the slate hue (214°), solved to Y 0.965: as light as it can go for text contrast while a post edge stays visible on a white feed. Cool on purpose, so it never reads as a warm ivory.

navy.$description: Ink on paper, and the dark ground. The professional layer.

paper.$description: Decorative dividers on paper, the same cool hue as paper at the old divider luminance. Structural lines use slate-mid.

navy.$description: Decorative dividers and grids on navy. Structural lines use slate-light.

raised.$description: A component that sits on paper: a field, an open list. White, one step lighter than paper; the border does the separating.

hover.$description: Hovered row inside a raised component: navy at 7 % over white. One row at a time, the one under the pointer.

magenta.$description: Strength, energy, resilience, fashion. The hero colour: it carries statements, never decoration.
